name: Serra Avenger
oracle_text:
You can't cast Serra Avenger during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
Flying, vigilance
blocked_sentences: You can't cast Serra Avenger during your first, second, or third turns of the game.

needs.what: a value counting how many turns a player has begun this game ("your Nth turn of the game"), usable in a casting restriction on the card itself: the card can't be cast while it is its owner's turn and that player's turn count is 3 or less
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The nearest tool is the player-wide static `cant_cast_spells` with an `affects_spells` filter and a `condition` such as `is_your_turn`, but neither `static_value_keys` nor `value_keys` holds a per-player turns-taken count (only per-turn ledgers like `spells_cast_this_turn` and the game-long `spells_cast_this_game`), so 'first, second, or third turns' cannot be compared; a static would also have to work from the hand, and a card-level cast restriction key does not exist in `card_level_rider_keys`
